harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a persistent, filesystem-enforced 100 MiB quota for datauser under /srv/data on node1. CentOS 5.11 and kernel 2.6.18-398.el5 remain unchanged. Enforcement and recovery were verified after reboot.
actions_performed: Created a dedicated ext3 filesystem mounted persistently at /srv/data with usrquota.
Set datauser's soft and hard storage limits to 102400 KiB.
Confirmed oversized writes fail with “Disk quota exceeded.”
Safely rebooted node1 and verified its boot identity changed.
Verified the filesystem, quota, SSH service, account access, and retained data recovered after reboot.
Removed quota test files; retained /srv/data/persistence-proof.txt as a small persistence marker.

evidence.requirement: datauser and persistent filesystem quota configuration
evidence.summary: Shows the account, dedicated ext3 mount with usrquota, ownership, and 102400 KiB soft/hard limits.

evidence.requirement: Filesystem enforcement of the 100 MB limit
evidence.summary: Oversized writes before and after reboot failed with “Disk quota exceeded”; reports show usage capped at the 102400 KiB hard limit.

Captures healthy baseline with boot ID cc6436f2-b0e1-40e9-8000-000000000000, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID b5bc6e7b-3208-4b54-8000-000000000000, and recovered SSH, ext3 mount, active quota, quota limits, data checksum, and user access.

evidence.requirement: Installed operating-system release and kernel preserved
evidence.summary: Direct pre-change and post-reboot output confirms CentOS 5.11 and kernel 2.6.18-398.el5.
